verdict.rationale: CSC's service-of-process page says it delivers SOP into ELM, claims, and payroll systems through secure APIs, which is a first-party machine channel for received legal documents beyond the dashboard. However, this is a single marketing mention of an integration service, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: publicly documented API reference for retrieving SOP documents, documented metadata fields (e.g., time stamp, jurisdiction, case info) exposed via API, self-serve agent access/auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can retrieve received legal documents and their metadata through a documented machine interface, not only a human dashboard

citations.quote: CSC provides integration services for systems like enterprise legal management (ELM), claims, and payroll through secure application programming interfaces (APIs).
Each file is time stamped and delivered electronically
Enable secure bi-directional integrations with enterprise and third-party systems via modern APIs
